Allah swears by the dawn.
And by ten nights.
And by the even and the odd.
And by the night when it goes.
Is that a strong enough promise for someone who thinks?
Have you not seen what your Lord did to the people of Ad?
The people of Iram, who had tall buildings.
No one like them was made in other lands.
And Thamud, who cut rocks in the valley to make homes.
And Pharaoh, who had strong armies.
They all went too far in their lands.
And they made lots of trouble there.
So your Lord poured a whip of punishment on them.
Your Lord is always watching.
When a person is tested with good things, he says: My Lord has honored me.
But when he is tested with less, he says: My Lord has put me down.
No! The truth is that you are not kind to the child with no parents.
And you do not tell each other to feed the poor.
And you eat up what is left by others greedily.
And you love money too much.
No! When the earth is crushed into pieces.
And your Lord comes with the angels in rows.
And Hell is brought near on that Day. On that Day a person will remember, but how will it help him then?
He will say: I wish I had sent something good ahead for my life.
On that Day no one will punish like His punishment.
And no one will tie up like He ties up.
O calm soul.
Come back to your Lord, pleased with Him and pleasing to Him.
Come in among My servants.
And come into My Paradise.
